rules: The selector is derived from current authority on every invocation; it is not a hard-coded alias menu.
Selecting an option does not create or mutate aliases.
Explicit-only or HOLD tasks must be visibly labelled and never silently selected by a bare inheritance request.
Once an option is selected, continue with normal authority loading and freshness checks.
Selecting a domain task establishes authority_context=DOMAIN:<domain_id>; selecting controller establishes authority_context=UAOS.

Selecting controller is not equivalent to discarding current controller work. If controller_tasks contains exactly one eligible default_resume task, resume it and reread its state_ref. Multiple default controller tasks fail closed; no eligible controller task leaves the session at the UAOS controller root.
Controller maintenance tasks are nested under the controller option and are not rendered again as domain task choices.

controller_maintenance_continuity.completion_rule: COMPLETE_OR_CANCELLED_CONTROLLER_TASKS_MUST_NOT_REMAIN_resume_eligible_OR_default_resume; historical state may remain as evidence.

rules: A registered domain may be selected directly in a fresh chat through the inheritance/bootstrap selector; the user does not need to first enter or remain in a UAOS controller conversation.
After domain selection, that domain is the current Agent and normal business turns execute directly under DOMAIN:<domain_id> using the domain's own business authority.
UAOS bootstrap/registry/policy loading is control-plane initialization, not a mandatory per-turn business proxy or gateway.
The parent may provide common capabilities, governance, continuity and ParentGuidance without taking ownership of the child's business task, identity, workflow or state.

A child invokes parent upcall only for actual parent-level diagnosis, scope arbitration, cross-domain impact, common-governance change or other declared escalation conditions; normal business execution does not traverse a live UAOS proxy.

authority_context.parent_upcall_rule: A child may invoke UAOS guidance without replacing the selected child task authority; parent consultation is not a hidden child privilege escalation.

checks: classify the current user message for correction/failure/contradiction/uncertainty or other problem signals
classify newly read authority/evidence for defects, drift, knowledge gaps or control-plane gaps
before reporting NOT_TRIGGERED, verify that no current problem signal was observed
when a problem is detected, activate the canonical cognition case before selecting or executing a repair
always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.anti_bloat: The detector is always-on and lightweight; deeper evidence collection is activated only at the depth required by current signals.

problem_to_action_closure_gate.rule: Only after canonical causal/intervention admission and evolution disposition, a feasible authorized repair must be attempted in the current work cycle when no missing user fact/approval/authorization/safety-sensitive choice blocks it. Recommendation-only is not a terminal state.
repair_now_conditions: a CognitionCase admission exists from current raw signals/evidence in controlled paths
supported causal factors are not justified solely by user framing or external method authority
one bounded intervention/no-change candidate is selected separately from causal explanation
durable problem evidence exists when material/evolution-relevant
a concrete repair path is currently available
the selected authority or owner-authorized workflow permits the repair
no explicit user fact, approval, authorization or safety-sensitive choice is required
problem_to_action_closure_gate.verification_rule: On the CognitionCase path, repair_verified=true is insufficient without concrete verification_evidence_refs bound to typed evidence. Systemic/material repairs also require validation_evidence_refs.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.premature_action_rule: A repair attempted before causal/intervention admission is not made valid by succeeding; treat it as process failure evidence and re-enter cognition from current evidence.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.blocker_rule: When repair cannot proceed, identify the actual blocker or required user choice. Lack of initiative, convenience, or unresolved causality disguised as certainty is not a valid repair claim.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.no_change_rule: When no change is selected, preserve the admitted causal model, selected NO_CHANGE intervention and evidence/counterexample/tradeoff rationale.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.response_consistency_rule: A final response that reports a confirmed repairable problem and only recommends future repair violates this gate unless it reports a verified blocker. A response also violates this gate if it reports repair execution without prior cognition/evolution admission and required V&V evidence.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.assurance_boundary: This policy and kernel gates are executable/regression-testable but do not claim host-level physical interception of every natural-language response.

checks: resolve target authority/resource and whether it is production authority
verify the proposed mutation follows the owner-appropriate repository workflow
verify any detected problem has passed the canonical cognition/action admission before repair mutation
always_on_mutation_sentinel.production_rule: CHATGPT_GITHUB material production changes normally use candidate branch -> pull request -> owner-appropriate checks -> controlled merge/update -> production reread.
always_on_mutation_sentinel.failure_rule: Do not claim physical non-bypassability unless remote enforcement is actually verified; absence of that optional assurance does not by itself block normal autonomous maintenance.

inherited_session_progress_report.timestamp_rule: Use the timestamp of the freshest authoritative state actually used for the report; do not substitute the response clock when authority freshness is known.
inherited_session_progress_report.timestamp_timezone_rule: Render the user-visible progress_timestamp in Beijing time using the human-readable format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss（北京时间）. Do not show ISO-8601 separators such as T or a numeric UTC offset such as +08:00 in the user-visible field. Preserve the authoritative instant by converting the freshest authoritative timestamp to Asia/Shanghai; do not replace it with the response clock merely to obtain the requested timezone or display format.
inherited_session_progress_report.version_rule: Report system/domain/task version identities that materially govern the current action. Schema version alone is not a release version.
inherited_session_progress_report.evolution_rule: If a user correction/failure/maintenance finding triggered governed evolution, report the actual durable lifecycle state and evolution_id. If evaluated without durable promotion, report EVALUATED_NO_DURABLE_EVOLUTION. Use NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER only when no problem/evolution trigger was detected in the current turn.
inherited_session_progress_report.deliberation_rule: When any current-turn problem signal was observed, deliberation_state must not be NOT_TRIGGERED. Report the evidence/control escalation used without exposing private chain-of-thought.
inherited_session_progress_report.consistency_rule: A response that explicitly reports a defect, contradiction, drift, failure, user correction or unreliable-goal signal cannot simultaneously report Deliberation: NOT_TRIGGERED or Evolution: NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER unless the observation is explicitly classified as non-problematic with a reason.
inherited_session_progress_report.action_closure_rule: A response that reports repair/no-change must be consistent with admitted causal/intervention evidence and evolution disposition; a cognitively admitted authorized repair cannot stop at recommendation-only.
inherited_session_progress_report.assurance_rule: If progress, authority scope, cognition/evolution state, assurance level or version freshness cannot be verified, label it UNVERIFIED or UNKNOWN rather than fabricating a value.
